description:
Create a standardized tissue atlas project in InVesalius 3 using the loaded CT Cranium dataset. You must create exactly three segmentation masks with specific names and Hounsfield Unit (HU) threshold ranges. 

1. Create a mask named 'Dense_Bone' with range 662 to 3071 HU.
2. Create a mask named 'Spongy_Bone' with range 148 to 661 HU.
3. Create a mask named 'Soft_Tissue' with range -700 to 147 HU.

Ensure the mask names are exact (case-sensitive) and the threshold values are precise. Save the project as an InVesalius 3 project file to '/home/ga/Documents/tissue_atlas.inv3'.
